# Texas Real Estate Fund

> Texas Real Estate Fund is a newly established real estate investment firm based in Houston, Texas. It identifies real estate investment opportunities with a focus on long-term value creation. Tagline: "Beyond the Property."

## Key facts
- Name: Texas Real Estate Fund
- Type: Boutique real estate investment firm
- Headquarters: Houston, Texas, United States
- Founded: 2026
- Focus: Real estate investment opportunities in Texas with a long-term value perspective
- Principles: Long-term perspective, disciplined evaluation, aligned partnerships, integrity and stewardship
- Approach: Identify, Evaluate, Structure, Steward
- Contact: info@texasrealestatefund.com (investment opportunities, potential partnerships, general inquiries)
